reasons: The cited clauses meet the preferred position on every material term: 12-month renewal terms (no multi-year auto-renewal), Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice, Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.
Deterministic check confirms the notice window is 30 days, well within the preferred ≤30-day threshold.
